title: Board list
description: `seq` is that board's own last ledger line; `head` is the ledger's; `locked` marks a board the person has locked. `readOnly` marks a ledger opened read-only.

board.description: The board id, which the other operations take in their path.

seq.description: The board's own last ledger line (`seq`).

locked.description: Present, and true, while the person has the board locked: read it as usual, but every write on it is refused with `locked` until the person unlocks it.

held.description: Present, and true, when you hold this board: write on it without asking; `request_grant` would answer `held`. Left out for a board you don't hold, or a container on it only.

project.description: The folder the board server has open, as the person reads it (`~/projects/example`); every board listed is in its ledger.

ledger.description: The ledger the board server has open in that folder; every board listed is in it. Given only with ledger folders.
ledger.$comment: ledgerFolders flag (LEDGERS_01, D-084 rule 3; D-083 rule 4)
